snippet.title: death  standing     「June 5th 2026」
snippet.description:
Death Standing comes out on Steam on June 5th 2026!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4627740/Death_Standing/

Death Standing is the first of its kind 'Stand' type of game, where the player has to do nothing but hold still for a set amount of time.

Survive for days and find out what fate has in store for the Baby, Death, and Kojira-san in this meditative endurance challenge game for the most hardcore of gamers!

Also features a leaderboard for the most competitive of baby holders.
